description: This file contains functions and types related to progress reporting, result printing, and failure hints for an update process in a CLI tool, specifically for the 'openclaw' project.

methods.name: getStepLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given update step based on predefined labels.

methods.name: inferUpdateFailureHints
methods.description: Provides hints based on the failure result of an update, especially for permission issues or native dependency build failures.

methods.name: createUpdateProgress
methods.description: Creates and returns a progress controller object that manages spinner animations during update steps.

methods.name: formatStepStatus
methods.description: Returns a status icon based on the exit code of a step.

methods.name: printResult
methods.description: Prints the update result summary, including steps, status, and recovery hints, in either JSON or formatted text.
